headline: Audits and external evaluations expose limits of single-cell foundation model claims
label: Auditing Foundation Model Benchmarks
summary: Single-cell and sequence foundation models face growing scrutiny over benchmark contamination, external replication, and leakage control.
synthesis: The common thread is evaluation discipline applied to learned models of cells and sequences. Minmax-CF selects real cells and genes for traceable data distillation, while scContam combines MinHash gene-set fingerprinting with loss-based membership inference to detect pretraining contamination in single-cell foundation model benchmarks. A pre-registered external evaluation of Geneformer, scGPT, and UCE on Replogle Perturb-seq (RPE1, K562) found that all beat controls but none reliably beats a strong baseline, a consistent partial-replication outcome across three transcriptomic models. Outside single-cell work, Muon reaches matched perplexity against Adam for regulatory DNA Transformers at reduced training cost, CHIMIYA-1 ranks first on four TDC ADMET endpoints under five-seed runs with a leakage audit, and AINN-Express predicts VHH expression from sequence with leave-program-out ROC-AUC 0.81. The items are heterogeneous; what is shared is explicit attention to auditability, leakage, and held-out validity rather than a single method.
